## Preface

This publication represents a major revision of the UK Standard Industrial 
Classification of Economic Activities (SIC), commenced in 2019 and completed in 
2026. It is the outcome of a series of consultations carried out in conjunction with a 
major revision of the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic 
Activities (ISIC Rev. 5) by the United Nations. A substantial amount of preparatory 
work must take place before SIC (2026) can be used operationally across the Office 
for National Statistics (ONS) systems. This is to ensure changes are introduced 
safely, consistently, and without compromising time series continuity. Introduction of 
SIC (2026) will commence in the business registers, in readiness for sampling for 
business surveys, and conclude with the implementation in the UK National
